b01.evidence: The digit has a top bar, descending leg and crossbar: 7. It is the dark authorial number at the head, so mspage is retained; margin would not change its ink reading. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b01.jpg; original box (836, 19, 904, 71).

b02.decision: Retain hatted-C doubt and (donc aussi; add uncertainty to cancelled est
b02.evidence: The hatted C remains retraced. The opening curved parenthesis and subsequent d/low onc bodies support (donc, not an independent Cela. The horizontal cancellation conceals the small middle body of est, so est remains preferred but et cannot be excluded; cancellation is certain. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b02.jpg; original box (1101, 405, 1655, 512).

b03.evidence: The hooked cap, stem and crossbar support the same F and the same unresolved printed-alphabet alternatives. Extra braces around F do not change the reading; the closing parenthesis is visible. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b03.jpg; original box (250, 530, 421, 633).

b04.decision: Retain infinity and hyphen; reopen the compressed word ending
b04.evidence: The first symbol has a closed left loop and a returning right loop, compatible with infinity rather than an ordinary omega. A separate hyphen follows. The low final word is too compressed to establish the full exe ending independently of context; retain connexe as preferred with conn as a possible short form. The final closing curve and comma are visible. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b04.jpg; original box (1437, 536, 1665, 632).

b05.evidence: The short dark body between F and the looped l is compact and thickened, consistent with the reduced a previously inspected, rather than a long separating dash. The F alphabet remains unresolved; added mathcal braces are syntax. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b05.jpg; original box (1062, 635, 1386, 744).

b06.decision: Retain first order of unresolved C alphabets
b06.evidence: Both readings identify a cancelled C-shaped character followed by live X=blackboard C and a period. The crossed interior cannot establish ordinary versus doubled C; neither ordering is resolved by the ink. Retain the first reading’s explicit doubt. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b06.jpg; original box (747, 744, 1060, 850).

b07.evidence: Two vertical P stems, one raised upright numeral 1, and a doubled C below are visible. Braces around the one-character exponent/alphabet arguments change no glyph. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b07.jpg; original box (703, 955, 822, 1041).

b08.decision: Add uncertainty to cancelled donc; retain disons insertion
b08.evidence: The raised replacement has a tall d, dotted i and the low sons continuation. The lower d and final c survive the strike, but the internal o/n bodies are partly merged with the cancellation; the old word remains donc only tentatively. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b08.jpg; original box (282, 1056, 453, 1139).

b09.evidence: The brace encloses exactly the X=P^1_C approximately S^2 row and Y={infinity} row. Both readings have the same objects, relation and grouping; array versus aligned and inline/display delimiters are typesetting differences. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b09.jpg; original box (550, 1104, 1049, 1295).

b10.decision: Retain tentative cancelled P and live C; do not add a punctuation point
b10.evidence: The dense cancellation leaves a looped upper body and strokes compatible with the tentative P; it is not settled enough to remove its doubt, but a formula-symbol illegible placeholder would discard this candidate. The isolated small dot adjacent to the hatching has no independently established punctuation role and can be cancellation/pen-contact residue; it is not promoted to a live point between the cancelled sign and C. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b10.jpg; original box (612, 1310, 976, 1411).

b12.decision: Retain dotted right vertical arrow and first diagram
b12.evidence: The right vertical shaft consists of separated small point-like strokes, unlike the longer horizontal dashes below. Both descend to one arrowhead. The upper connector has a curl at its left end and no right head; the left vertical is solid. Object/number/spacing macro differences are equivalent. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b12.jpg; original box (272, 1575, 1146, 1877).

b13.evidence: The large S and raised 2 agree; exponent braces do not change the source. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b13.jpg; original box (1280, 1876, 1416, 1949).

b14.decision: Equivalent F grouping; retain live topos
b14.evidence: Topos is retraced along its letters, with no independent crossing line establishing cancellation. Both readings keep it live and retain the same F alphabet doubt. The other token changes are mathcal/mathfrak argument braces. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b14.jpg; original box (287, 2096, 1037, 2202).

b15.decision: Retain comma and capital Pi; mark les/le uncertainty
b15.evidence: The word after sur has a tall looped l followed by very compressed low bodies and a terminal down-return; an independent final s is not secure, so les remains preferred but le is admitted. The mark after Pi_1 begins low and descends below the baseline like a comma, rather than enclosing the full-height object as a closing parenthesis. Pi has a flat cap and two straight legs. Crop: crops/second_151_scan039_b15.jpg; original box (1434, 2182, 1666, 2282).
